commons.title: 1940 Census Enumeration District Descriptions - Nevada - Elko County - ED 4-1, ED 4-2, ED 4-3A, ED 4-3B, ED 4-4 - NARA - 5850653.jpg
commons.credit: Unknown authorUnknown author or not provided
commons.description:
Scope and content:  This item lists Enumeration Districts for:
NV ED 4-1: TOWNSHIP 1, CONTACT.
NV ED 4-2: TOWNSHIP 1, C.C.C. CAMP G-108.
NV ED 4-3A: TOWNSHIP 2 BOUNDED BY STATE LINE; TUSCARORA-MOUNTAIN CITY-STATE LINE NEAR 115 DEGREES 50 MINUTE RD; TOWNSHIP LINE; ALSO MOUNTAIN CITY, PATSVILLE, RIO TINTO MINE.
NV ED 4-3B: TOWNSHIP 2 BOUNDED BY (N) STATE LINE; (E) TOWNSHIP LINE; (S) TOWNSHIP LINE; (W) TOWNSHIP LINE, TUSCARORA-MOUNTAIN CITY-STATE LINE NEAR 115 DEGREES 50 MINUTE RD; ALSO JARBIDGE.

NV ED 4-4: TOWNSHIP 3, WESTERN SHOSHONE AGENCY HOSPITAL.
commons.editorial_reason: Census enumeration document; no visible Western Shoshone cultural content.
